title: 第十七章  武道路艰凶熊出没第十八章  熊口逃生寻踪匿迹
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 河西县，振威武馆。
“简师兄，我有天赋，我有武道天赋啊！”
带着哀求的声音从门后响起。
陆川步伐一滞，退到一边。
只见两人从振威武馆内走出。
一名穿着武馆练功服，其胸前绣着‘振威武馆’四字的弟子，推搡着前方的一名麻布衣裳的瘦削青年。
两人一前一后，来到门口，被称为简师兄的武馆弟子猛地发力，将那青年一下推出大门。
青年脚步踉跄，跌倒在地，但还是强忍住疼痛，继续说道：
“师兄，我快练出气血了，再给我点时间。”
简师兄皱着眉，放缓了语气：
“席不凡，按时缴纳月奉，是馆主严格规定的。你已经拖延了三日，你我同门一场，大家不要闹得难堪。”
席不凡则继续说道：
“师兄，再给我三日时间，我就能练出气血。”
简师兄叹息一声：
“不凡，你的武道天赋是不错，只用了一个月时间便要练出第一缕气血，但是武道可不是单靠天赋这般简单。”
“你在武馆内一日三顿肉食，再加上各种药膳，一月少说得十几二十两银钱。
而你进入我武馆学武这个月，只让你缴纳三十两的月奉，已经是厚道的价格。”
“现在你不交钱，还想在我武馆白吃白喝，这天底下没有这样的道理。”
这话一出，青年席不凡一时说不出话来。
“你记住，武道修行，首先就是得有钱！”
简师兄看着眼前的席不凡，继续道：
“你天赋是好，但光凭天赋，只练而不进补，只会把自己练废。
看人家宋远师弟，虽然他天资比你差点，但钱能通神，他一月给一百两的月奉。
平时一日三顿珍肉，加上时时刻刻有上好的药膳进补，人家照样能够半月练出第一缕气血。”
席不凡听到这话，双手握紧，陷入了沉默。
“没有家底支撑，你还是老老实实放弃练武这路子吧，再练下去，你就真废了。”
说完，简师兄不再说话，转身进了振威武馆。
席不凡站在原地许久，这才缓缓离开。
而陆川则在一旁目睹了全程。
片刻后，他抬头看了看振威武馆的牌匾，转身离去。
看来想凭天赋进入武馆的路子是行不通了。
陆川默默地想着。
他满打满算也就二十两不到的家底，其中得留那十五两的税，剩下的才是余钱。
思前想后，陆川深吸一口气，有了决定。
在攒够练武的钱之前，他不能放弃打猎这条路子。
陆川转头朝着常松所在的箭摊走去。
不多时，常松看着陆川的身影，挥了挥手：
“小川，又来买箭了？”
陆川则回应一个笑容，说道：
“常伯，我攒够钱交税了，但打猎这条路子，我还是打算继续。”
常松点了点头，欣慰地说道：
“那就好啊，不过小川，你真不打算去参军？”

content_en:
Hexi County, Zhenwei Martial Arts Hall.
"Senior Brother Jian, I have talent, I have martial arts talent!"
A pleading voice sounded from behind the door.
Lu Chuan hesitated and stepped aside.
I saw two people walking out of Zhenwei Martial Arts Hall.
A disciple wearing a martial arts training uniform with the words "Zhenwei Martial Arts" embroidered on his chest pushed a thin young man in linen clothes in front of him.
The two of them came to the door one after another. The martial arts disciple known as Senior Brother Jian suddenly exerted force and pushed the young man out of the door.
The young man staggered and fell to the ground, but he still held back the pain and continued:
"Senior brother, I'm almost done with my Qi and blood, just give me some more time."
Senior Brother Jian frowned and softened his tone:
"Xi Bufan, paying your monthly salary on time is strictly stipulated by the host. You have been delayed for three days. You and I are in the same class, so please don't cause any embarrassment."
Xi Bufan continued:
"Senior brother, give me three more days and I will be able to practice Qi and blood."
Senior Brother Jian sighed:
"Feifan, your martial arts talent is pretty good. It only took you a month to develop your first qi and blood, but martial arts is not as simple as relying on talent alone."
"You eat three meat meals a day in the martial arts school, plus various medicinal foods, and you can earn at least ten or twenty taels of silver in a month.
And this month you enter our martial arts hall to learn martial arts, you only have to pay a monthly fee of thirty taels, which is already a generous price. "
"Now you don't pay, but you still want to eat and drink for free at my martial arts studio. There is no such reason in the world."
As soon as these words came out, the young man Xi Bufan was speechless for a moment.
"Remember, to practice martial arts, you must first have money!"
Senior Brother Jian looked at Xi Bufan in front of him and continued:
"Your talent is good, but relying solely on talent and practicing without supplements will only make you useless.
Look at Junior Brother Song Yuan, although his talent is not as good as yours, money can help you. He gives you a monthly salary of one hundred taels.
Usually eating three meals a day of delicacies, plus having good medicinal food tonic at all times, one can still develop the first ray of energy and blood in half a month. "
When Xi Bufan heard this, he clenched his hands and fell into silence.
"Without family support, you should just give up on practicing martial arts. If you keep practicing, you will be useless."
After saying that, Senior Brother Jian stopped talking and turned around and entered the Zhenwei Martial Arts Hall.
Xi Bufan stood there for a long time before slowly leaving.
Lu Chuan watched the whole process from the sidelines.
After a moment, he looked up at the plaque of Zhenwei Martial Arts Hall, turned around and left.
It seems that the way to enter a martial arts gym based on talent is not feasible.
Lu Chuan thought silently.
He had a fortune of less than twenty taels, of which he had to keep fifteen taels for taxes, and the rest was left over.
After thinking about it, Lu Chuan took a deep breath and made a decision.
He couldn't give up hunting until he saved enough money to practice martial arts.
Lu Chuan turned and walked towards the arrow stall where Chang Song was.
Not long after, Chang Song looked at Lu Chuan's figure and waved:
"Xiaochuan, are you here to buy arrows again?"
Lu Chuan responded with a smile and said:
"Uncle Chang, I have saved enough money to pay taxes, but I still plan to continue hunting."
Chang Song nodded and said happily:
"That's good, but Xiaochuan, are you really not going to join the army?"
